basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the marketplace model and pilot plan, including how it works alongside the regional distributors.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the blueprint and pilot plan to start the pilot?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Run the marketplace with contractors in one region and measure first repeat orders and distributor contract status.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the steering group sign off the pilot results to prepare the 2027 budget round?

workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which hypotheses on contractors, distributors and the marketplace model must hold for direct selling to work?
activities: Draft hypotheses for each marketplace blueprint component
Interview the CEO, Head of Sales and distributors council
Review order data from the existing B2B ordering portal

workstreams.name: Contractor demand
workstreams.answers: What do small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain need from an online marketplace to order repeatedly?
activities: Interview small and mid-size contractors on how they buy
Analyze sales data on smaller accounts by warehouse
Build and test a wireframe prototype with contractors

workstreams.name: Distributor coexistence
workstreams.answers: What role could regional distributors play in the marketplace, and what would make them stay?
activities: Interview regional distributors on their role and concerns
Review distributor contracts and sales data by region
Map where the marketplace and distributors overlap

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: Which marketplace model and pilot plan does the evidence support for a pilot in one region?
activities: Consolidate tested hypotheses into a blueprint
Detail the pilot plan for one region
Prepare the go/no-go pack for the steering group

workstreams.name: Pilot contractor group
workstreams.answers: Which contractors in the pilot region should be invited first, and what do they need to start ordering?
activities: Interview pilot-region contractors on ordering needs
Analyze sales data to segment contractors in the region
Agree the first target group with the Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Distributor alignment
workstreams.answers: Which pilot KPIs and distributor role do the CEO, Head of Sales and distributors council agree on?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO and Head of Sales
Hold regular reviews with the regional distributors council
Identify the internal roles the pilot needs

workstreams.name: Marketplace build and launch
workstreams.answers: Can the marketplace be built and launched to a first group of contractors in the pilot region?
activities: Review the existing B2B portal for reuse in the marketplace
Build the first marketplace version for the pilot region
Launch to the first group after the readiness review

workstreams.name: Pilot results and scale-up
workstreams.answers: Did contractors place first repeat orders, did any distributor contract end because of the marketplace, and what does scale-up need?
activities: Track repeat orders from pilot contractors
Interview contractors and distributors about the pilot
Draft the scale-up case and roadmap from the results

deliverables.name: Hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component
Contractor demand evidence on the marketplace hypotheses
Distributor overlap map and role options
Pilot plan and go/no-go pack for one region
First contractor target group for the pilot region
Pilot KPIs agreed with the CEO and Head of Sales
Distributor role in the pilot agreed with the council
First marketplace version launched to pilot contractors
Interim results on repeat orders and distributor contracts
Pilot results and scale-up case with roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, team and calendar
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the scope, team and calendar for the engagement?
agenda: Present the engagement objective and the two phases through week 20
Review the team, the steering meeting calendar and the success criteria
Confirm the scope, including how regional distributors are involved

events.label: Check-in: design findings
events.decision: Which hypotheses and distributor role options does the blueprint detail?
agenda: Present contractor demand evidence and the tested wireframe prototype
Review the distributor overlap map and the role options
Decide which options the blueprint and pilot plan detail

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether to start the pilot
events.decision: Does the steering group approve the blueprint and pilot plan to start the pilot?
agenda: Present the marketplace blueprint and the pilot plan for one region
Review how the pilot works alongside the regional distributors
Decide on the go/no-go to start the pilot

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the pilot goes live
events.decision: Is the pilot ready to go live with the target group, KPIs and distributor role?
agenda: Present the target contractor group, the pilot KPIs and the distributor role
Review launch readiness of the first marketplace version
Decide whether the pilot is ready to go live

events.label: Workshop 2: interim results
events.purpose: Review interim results and the scale-up case
events.decision: Which scale-up options should the final readout case detail?
agenda: Present interim results on repeat orders and distributor contracts
Review the first marketplace version launched to pilot contractors
Discuss the emerging scale-up case and roadmap ahead of the final readout

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Sign off pilot results, prepare budget round
events.decision: Does the steering group sign off the pilot results to prepare the 2027 budget round?
agenda: Present the pilot results and the scale-up case with roadmap
Review repeat orders and distributor contract status against the criteria
Decide the sign-off and what carries into the 2027 budget round preparation

architect_notes: The 6-week Design and 14-week Pilot split of the stated 20 weeks is our estimate; confirm 14 weeks is enough for repeat orders.
The marketplace is new, so the plan stops at the pilot; rollout to other regions and markets is not in these phases.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, digital product passports under Construction Products Regulation. Confirm whether it is in scope.
